/* =========================================================
   Logo section ("Non-exclusive List of Celsius Assets")

   Layout follows the table in the guidelines doc:
     Row 1 (--row--one)   6 logos            6 columns
     Row 2 (--row--two)   5 word marks       6 columns, last one spans 2
     Row 3 (--row--three) 3 can assets       3 columns (= 2 doc columns each)
     Row 4 (--row--four)  3 campaign assets  3 columns

   Sizes live in custom properties so breakpoints only swap numbers.

.cel-tm-logos {
  --cel-col-gap: 24px;

  --cel-wordmark-gap: 4px;   /* row 2 sits right under row 1, as in the doc */

  --cel-can-h: 150px;        /* row 3 */
  --cel-campaign-h: 130px;   /* row 4 Vibes logo */
  --cel-item-min-h: 150px;
  --cel-text-min-h: 64px;    /* word mark cells */
  --cel-text-size: 1.125rem;

.cel-tm-logos .cel-tm-logos__grid {

  align-items: center;
  justify-items: center;

.cel-tm-logos .cel-tm-logos__grid > :not(li),
.cel-tm-logos .cel-tm-logos__item > p:empty,
.cel-tm-logos .cel-tm-logos__item > br {

  letter-spacing: inherit;

/* Images */

  display: block;
  width: auto;
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  max-height: var(--cel-logo-h);

/* Word mark images (row 2, and items 2 and 3 of row 4).
